_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Smart PVR is now available as one self-contained MATLAB file, with no helper files or toolbox requirements. A three-page illustrated guide explains deflation selection, filtering, SNR, joined Gaussian halves, supported recovery, and the final peak+5/cap/fallback policy.

Download smart_pvr_offline.m for the single function, Smart_PVR_Algorithm_Guide.pdf for sharing, or the MATLAB ZIP for both plus the modular research sources. The installer also includes these files and the updated Help page.

Validation: 12 isolated MATLAB R2026a cases exactly match all modular outputs and diagnostics; 105 focused release/help/runner/profile checks and five-preset standalone/GUI parity pass. Every PDF page was rendered and visually reviewed.

GUI and standalone share the same firmware runner/settings. Native MATLAB and the faster embedded implementation can differ numerically. This handoff changes no estimator or firmware logic. Firmware remains rev27v-followup-348 (11/10/2026), with accepted peak+5 capped at 130 for Smart Const or 140 for High Max, and rejected analyses at 80. No new hardware flash or soak applies to this analyzer/documentation update.

Application source: c84fd32552c3a3439dda70058b00e71c141850a9, Default branch. The clean installer build receipt is attached as SmartCuff_Build_Receipt.json. Installer: 224448514 bytes; SHA-256 99cd48e0d7876b5a33e2db1eff36be89c5ce75c55adb5c1d20a5e719bdd78936. Authenticode is unsigned, as previously authorized. On a first installation, select More info -> Run anyway if Windows SmartScreen asks.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
